tts_summary: Hey there! Thor is right at that energetic one-year mark — many Pitbulls at this age are still exuberant, people-focused, big-hearted and testing boundaries as adolescents. You know how their strength and chewing drive show up during play? Here's the thing: this is prime time for solidifying recall, impulse control, and continuing safe social experiences; many vets often discuss spay/neuter timing around this age and keeping up preventive care. Day-to-day you’re juggling long yard runs, training bursts, and quick cleanups after messy play. With Thor's big yard and warm weather, staying stocked on water, cooling and calming aids matters. I’ve set autoship for staples so you don’t run out — check the recommendations below.
